youtube.baslik: How many decibels make a sound twice as loud? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Above 40 phons, loudness doubles for roughly every 10-phon increase: 50 phons is 2 sones, 60 phons is 4 sones and 70 phons is 8 sones. In short, a tenfold increase in intensity, or 10 dB, only doubles perceived loudness.
